notes.text:
This update for libzypp fixes the following issue

- CVE-2026-25707: Handcrafted repo metadata may cause arbitrary local files to be overwritten (bsc#1259802).
- CVE-2026-44942: Fixed possible path traversal attacks via .repo files 'path=' entries (bsc#1267874).
